name: Play! Play! Play! San
original_name: プレイ！プレイ！プレイ！惨
source:
This is the story of a bullied young man who one day suddenly got a "gun".
That was the day that launched his revenge!
Absurd power turned a perfectly normal, peaceful lad into a rape demon that wetly ruined every girl on his wishlist!

Choose from bully girl, cousin, petite girl, selfish girl, studious girl, baseball tomboy, dancer, elder girl next door, delivery driver, dog lover, librarian, president's wife, bodyguard, bakery girl and more! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE113805.html]DLsite English[/url]]
